DiagnosticDeviceId.description: Source device identifier; DEN and H identifiers imply no executable get.

FdaDrugApplication.description: Cell-owned drug application preserving native NDA/BLA prefix and leading zeros.

GeneSymbol.description: Source spelling of a gene symbol, with ASCII case-insensitive identity.

GtrTestType.description: Native GTR relation test category, not an offering or authorization judgment.

NcbiGeneId.description: A positive NCBI Gene identifier in canonical decimal text.

Text.description: Nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

description: Search one diagnostic source. A listing is not authorization; a companion row is not a treatment recommendation.

biomarker.description: Exact table-0 biomarker cell; unsupported in the group table.

bundle_revision.description: Immutable stored bundle revision retained by a continuation.

device_id.description: Exact PMA application, application/supplement or native K identity.

gene.description: Exact source gene_symbol field, without alias expansion.

gene_id.description: Exact source GeneID, exclusive with gene symbol.

limit.description: Five results by default; at most fifty source rows or product headers.

manufacturer.description: Literal whole-word phrase in WHO's Manufacturer name cell.

marker.description: Literal whole-word phrase in WHO's Pathogen/Disease/Marker cell.

source.description: Explicit native GTR, WHO IVD or FDA companion discovery.

title: DiagnosticSearch
